prompts.prompt: Create a production game sprite sheet, transparent RGBA background, for one opponent character in a cute hand-painted dark-fantasy stone-castle tower-defense educational game. Subject: a small moss-covered stone apprentice guardian, amber eyes, leafy hood, little wooden rune staff, friendly expressive face, full body 3/4 facing viewer-left. Exactly 12 isolated frames in an exact 4-column by 3-row evenly spaced rectangular grid, no text, no borders, no floor, no shadows outside individual character, no overlapping neighboring cells. Each cell identical size, consistent identity/scale/baseline, character centered with generous transparent safety margins. Reading left to right then next row, frames0,1 idle breathing/blinking; frames2,3 thoughtful hand to chin then raised eyebrow; frames4,5 casting with staff raised and small green magical spark; frames6,7 startled hit recoil with shocked/worried eyes; frames8,9 victorious smiling cheer arms up; frames10,11 defeated sad slumped posture eyes down. Both frames in each pair must visibly differ in movement. Stylized painted game illustration, clear silhouette, gold-trimmed stone details matching fantasy dungeon sprites. Not pixel art, not photorealism. Entire image aspect ratio 4:3, e.g.1536x1152, grid exact, transparent background.
